text: 1. A scanned copy of the information page of a valid passport;2. Proof of the highest academic degree, transcripts of all courses during the highest academic degree education stage (original scanned copies and English translations);3. Id photo (2-inch blue-background, bareheaded photo);4. Scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners", which must be filled out in either Chinese or English;5. English self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);6. Proof of language proficiency;7. Scanned copies of the "Economic Guarantee Letter" and its guarantee materials, which must be filled out in Chinese or English;8. Two copies of the "Guardian's Guarantee Letter" (which must be notarized), signed (provided by applicants under the age of 18 by October 20, 2025. If the notarization location is not in China, the notarization mark of the Chinese embassy or consulate in the local area must also be affixed).9. Non-recent graduates must provide their personal resumes.
